reviewContext.userProblem: Nodetto cannot present a document as a slideshow. Users need a PowerPoint-style full-screen presentation of pages in tab order, rendered read-only and fitted to the screen, with keyboard, mouse and control-bar navigation, and a per-page flag to skip pages.
requiredOutcomes: Optional Page.hiddenInPresentation is validated as a boolean, round-trips in JSONL and Yjs, and is edited only through the updatePage patch with exact undo. Flagless documents are byte-identical.
Pure core presentation module: slideList, startIndex, navigation reducer, fitSlide, slideSource (with effective inherited visibility) and svgSize, all with tests.

ui-solid PresentationView plus a DOM-free controller and key map, with tests: slide rendered as a data-URL img from the existing SVG exporter, counter, keys including number+Enter and B, exit callback, and key isolation.
Desktop: F5 and Shift+F5 (not in editable targets), the File menu items, the header Present button, Tauri or DOM fullscreen with overlay fallback, and a return to the last shown page.
Page tab menu item and inspector switch for the flag. Docs and the README describe the feature.
constraints: No new core Command kind; use the updatePage patch.
Documents without the flag round-trip byte-identically; the setter removes the key instead of writing false.
Presentation captures every key (stopImmediatePropagation), and window-input returns early while presenting.
apps/desktop/src-tauri/gen/schemas stays byte-identical. The exporter, layer-state and the CLI are untouched.
Public repository: no server or auth code. No emojis. gitPush false.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Rendering reuses renderArtboardSvg/renderPageSvg through Editor.exportArtboardSvg/exportPageSvgOf, shown as a data-URL img, to avoid defs id collisions with the mounted canvas.
Artboard: exactly one frame that is visible by inherited visibility (createShapeContext.isHidden), otherwise the content bbox; a null artboard export falls back to the page render (PRS-DESIGN-001).
prs-02 owns the single core barrel line, because @nodetto/core has no subpath exports and wave-2 ui-solid must import it.
ui-solid behavior lives in a DOM-free controller, because ui-solid tests run without a DOM.
Core function names are prefixed (reducePresentation, currentSlide, slideCounter) for barrel uniqueness; behavior is unchanged.
intentionalTradeoffs: Mixed-version cloud clients may drop the flag when an older client edits the page.
Next on the last slide clamps; there is no end screen (user-qa Q4 default).
supportedEdgeCases: Start on a hidden page goes to the next visible page, or the last slide
Empty page gives a blank slide
Browser Esc fullscreen exit ends the presentation
Frame inside a hidden group is not an artboard
residualRisks: WKWebView fullscreen behavior is verified only through the Tauri API path and manual use
Long data URLs for large embedded images
